items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: [Dick Allen] ... Was Frank Lane the manager? You did what? You think you did, anyway.

ctx.x: I used to play a lot of people. I used to play the Hattiesburg Country Club. I used to play the Hattiesburg Country Club.

Oh, that was a not-willing job. I stayed in Admiral Simms for one of my honeymoons. You did? Was Frank Lane the manager? You did what? You think you did, anyway. I think I spent the night there. My honeymoon night, I spent that.

Sule College. Look at the president of Sule College. You see, this was in a fire. I had two washrooms windows when I lived on Cadiz Street, and we used one for the library, and the fire had to break out our face.
